I have solid basics in object-oriented programming (Java, C#, Python), back-end (Python FastAPI, PHP, JSON endpoints), front-end (Vue 3, TypeScript, Nuxt) and SQL databases. I am comfortable with Git, Docker and Agile. I want to design features end to end, from the database to the screens.
